reader.requirement: Every elementary MOVE between the five 1985 categories (alphabetic, alphanumeric, alphanumeric edited, numeric integer/noninteger, numeric edited) is legal or refused exactly as Table 1 says: the No cells (alphabetic or alphanumeric edited to numeric/numeric edited, numeric or numeric edited to alphabetic, noninteger numeric to alphanumeric/alphanumeric edited) are refused, and each Yes cell is performed by GR4a/4b/4c, with literals and figurative constants classed per GR3 (SPACE alphabetic, ZERO numeric toward numeric receivers, every other figurative alphanumeric).

reader.notes: Every Yes and No cell of the 1985 Table 1 was probed at --std 85 and matched; the 1985-only legality of alphanumeric figurative constants into numeric receivers takes its own edition arm in FigurativeAssociation.GateSr5 and is admitted. The diagnostics cite the 2023 clause numbers (SR10, Table 16), which is a wording matter, not a conformance defect. GR3d (level 1 refuses numeric edited to numeric) is a level-1 restriction; the compiler implements level 2, where de-editing is legal.
